title: Frailty in Hip or Knee Arthroplasty Patients.
official: The Role of Frailty in the Rehabilitation Pathway Following Hip or Knee Arthroplasty Surgery.
summary: The study aims to understand the existing differences between frail and non-frail subjects who underwent a rehabilitation path after receiving hip or knee arthroplasty surgery.
